papers.title: Stochastic Domination of Gaussian Maxima: A Resolution to the Weak Simplex Conjecture
papers.abstract: We prove a stochastic comparison for Gaussian maxima. papers.title: Investigating anomalous microwave emission near G107.2+5.20 in Ku-band with the Green Bank Telescope
papers.abstract: Anomalous microwave emission (AME) is 30 GHz-peaking continuum emission thought to arise from spinning dust grains. Observations suggest that the local environment shapes the AME spectral energy distribution (SED), so building a spatially resolved sample of AME regions is a key step towards understanding its emission mechanism. papers.title: Entropy release from Minkowski breaking in regular Schwarzschild black holes
papers.abstract: The classical formation of a Schwarzschild black hole from a regular, non-singular configuration has recently been shown to be impossible within general relativity: the geometry inevitably develops a discontinuity at the origin, a phenomenon termed Minkowski breaking by Ovalle, Casadio, and Kamenshchik [PRD 113 (2026), 064042]. This obstruction signals that the transition to the Schwarzschild point mass must be a discrete, quantum event. We uncover the thermodynamic footprint of this transition.

papers.title: Pair-Partition Constructions for CPM-Based Quantum LDPC Codes
papers.abstract: We construct binary Calderbank--Shor--Steane (CSS) quantum low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes from circulant permutation matrices (CPMs). The construction is parameterized by column weight J, row weight L, and prime lift size P. A J x J array of pair partitions imposes linear paired-difference equations on the CPM exponents. papers.title: Cold Stream Penetration of Virial Shocks: Fragmentation, Coagulation, and Disruption in the Hot Circumgalactic Medium
papers.abstract: Cold streams penetrating virial shocks of massive halos along cosmic web filaments are expected to fuel galaxy growth at high redshift, yet the physical processes governing their penetration remain uncertain. papers.title: VideoRAE: Taming Video Foundation Models for Generative Modeling via Representation Autoencoders
papers.abstract: Video generative models commonly rely on latent spaces learned by 3D Variational Autoencoders (3D-VAEs).
